text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, ciprofloxacin hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Current inventory across three sites ranges from 13.2 to 29.5 days on hand for 250 mg tablets and 23.2 to 29 days for 500 mg tablets. Corvale General 250 mg stock is lowest at 13.2 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows ciprofloxacin hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A label for Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) shows a VAI inspection on 2026-07-16, an OAI inspection in 2009, and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08 for the same FEI. The top-ranked supplier Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term but uneven across sites. No national shortage exists per FDA. We should secure additional 250 mg supply for Corvale General and monitor usage trends.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders for 250 mg tablets from Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC to replenish Corvale General; buyer approves.
2. Buyer evaluates Aurobindo Pharma Limited as secondary source for 250 mg tablets; buyer approves.
3. Inventory team redistributes excess 250 mg stock from Corvale East to Corvale General; pharmacy director approves.
4. Buyer monitors FDA shortage list weekly and reports changes to committee; buyer approves.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative fluoroquinolones or changing formulary status based on current inventory levels.
